orientationControl.basis: The 2016 grove-side photo shows the roofed entrance to the sacred path past the arch’s forked pier. A geotagged photo shows the same shelter, with a swept bamboo eave, recessed plaster opening and adjoining scalloped wall, near survey point 32. The tagged camera is southwest of the arch, on the outer side beside the fork. The model faces about 211° true across the nearby PMTiles branch. The 2 m shift east of the survey point clears both mapped roads. The exact crossing and bearing are estimated.
